desc:
🧸 Trade Jellycats!

✨ Collect your favorite Jellycats.
💎 Some Jellycats are rarer than others!
🎁 Open plush crates to grow your collection.
🤝 Trade with friends to complete your dream inventory.

HOW TO TRADE:

1. Stand on a trading board with someone else.
2. Place the Jellycats you want to trade.
3. Both players step on ✅ to accept.
4. Jump on ❌ to cancel.
5. Jump on ➕ to request more Jellycats.

Happy Trading! 🧸💕

Tags: Jellycat, Plushies, Plush, Cute, Trading, Collecting, Rare, Cozy, Pop It Trading, Trade
